name: arxiv-daily
description: Daily fetch and digest of the newest arXiv cs.AI papers into LEARNING/research/arxiv_daily

job.shell: python3 LEARNING/research/arxiv_daily/pipeline/fetch_arxiv.py && python3 LEARNING/research/arxiv_daily/pipeline/make_digest.py && git add LEARNING/research/arxiv_daily && git commit -qm "chore(arxiv-daily): digest $(date +%F)"
